summary: Replacement stove control knob with reinforced D-bore hub for 6mm D-shaft, rated for high heat in ASA.
assumptions: 42mm OD x 28mm tall knob body assumed
20mm bore depth with 0.1mm total clearance for ASA press-fit

parts.name: Stove Control Knob
parts.purpose: press-fits onto 6mm metal D-shaft and transmits turning torque without cracking

print.orientation: print flat top face down on bed, bore opening facing up, no brim needed
